answer.rationale: Use targeted in-product activation messaging to reinforce time-to-value and product value for price-sensitive SMB accounts without immediately sacrificing price or retention. Prior activation messaging improved week-one engagement, while promotional pricing produced acquisition lift but materially harmed 30-day retention, making broad discounting inconsistent with sustainable qualified revenue. Run a guarded test focused on at-risk SMB cohorts and monitor qualified revenue, churn, retention, and first meaningful action before scaling.
